items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the commission is not site-attributable, so site revenue claims are unsupported. AI usage reports $886.12 across 4,865 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are absent, monthly budget limits are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold is defined. Continue only existing period-aligned reconciliation using recorded telemetry; retain all opportunities as deferred backlog.
